articles.title: Families of two police officers killed in crash say they were heroes
articles.description: PC Matthew Blades and PC Tom Clough died after a car, whose five occupants were also killed, collided with their vehicle.

articles.title: How easy is it to find an NHS dentist? It depends where you live
articles.description: Nearly 600 practices in England have withdrawn from NHS dentistry over the last 10 years, as the service heads towards a two-tier system.

articles.title: Burnham to visit Kyiv on first foreign trip and reaffirm UK support for Ukraine
articles.description: It comes after Moscow warned of "consequences" over the reported use of British drones by Ukraine.

articles.title: CrossCountry to provide full service on Monday after major disruption
articles.description: CrossCountry says its "key priority" is now restoring as close to a normal service as possible.
